senses.definition: A prize or honor given for an achievement.
senses.example: Ravi got an award for helping new students.

senses.definition: To give someone something for an achievement or as the result of a decision.
senses.example: The judges will award the trophy on Saturday.

senses.definition: Knowing that something is happening or exists.
senses.example: I was not aware of the open window until the breeze blew in.
That was an awesome drawing of the dragon.

senses.definition: Hard to move, use, or fit comfortably.
senses.example: The long package was awkward to carry on the bus.

senses.definition: Making you feel uncomfortable or unsure what to do.
senses.example: We had an awkward moment when we both reached for the last chair.

senses.definition: An imaginary or real line around which something turns.
senses.example: A spinning top turns around its axis.

senses.definition: A line on a graph along which values are marked and measured.
senses.example: The bottom axis shows the days of the week.

senses.definition: A rod on which a wheel turns or that turns with a wheel.
senses.example: The wheels of the toy truck spun around a metal axle.
